title: Voltus' Neon Nightmare - Colossal Cure
description:
WARNING :IT IS RECOMMENDED DOWLOADING AND PLAYING THE FIRST CHAPTER Of VOLTUS' NEON NIGHTMARE BEFORE PLAYING THIS GAME !

If you're into both liminal space and mascot horror games, this is the perfect game for you.

In this 2nd chapter of the Voltus' Neon Nightmare franchise, you'll have to continue making your way to the Core, in this endless mall that became a liminal nightmare to live in.

Use your elemental laser gun to guide you through the doors and the dark, as you try to escape while getting the Core in your hands.

Find some friends to help you, and getting your way into this world will be easier than you expect, because your enemies could be everywhere, hunting you down to make sure you don't even approach the Center.

After the events of the first chapter, you realized that this "mall" place was a trap to send you to another dimension, full of liminal and unknown places. Voltus is now controlled by the Core's energy, forced to keep you away from it. You'll have to find a way to escape from your cage, and with the help you'll find on your way to the Core itself, you'll have to cure Voltus from his madness, so there will no longer be any obstacle between you and the Core.

The Core is an unlimited source of energy, so powerful that it could either save or destroy the entire planet. Finding the Core is essential to the world's future, as we need a new source of energy for humanity, to keep our world safe from any danger.

Explore liminal spaces, meet new friends and enemies, find the Core, and escape this endless world of chaos.
description_short: After the previous events, you realized that this "mall" place was a trap to send you to another dimension, full of liminal and unknown places. Voltus is now controlled by the Core's energy, forced to keep you away from it.
